title: falsifiable project config (.claude/falsifiable.json)
description: Every key is optional; a missing key takes its default. Arrays replace their default, objects merge with it.

guard.description: What the guard hook blocks. Every pack is on by default.

protectedBranches.description: Branches agents never push to, force-push or commit to through an MCP tool.

localHosts.description: Database hosts that count as local. Any other host is treated as production.

protectedPaths.description: Globs agents never write. Added to the built-in set: .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json, .claude/falsifiable.json, .claude/hooks/**, .mcp.json. A glob matches at any folder depth.

unlockEnv.description: An environment variable that, set to 1 when a person starts the session, lets that session change protected paths.

blockCommands.description: Extra commands to block, matched on the words of each simple command after the guard unwraps env, sudo, npx and similar.

delivery.description: How /falsifiable:ship plans and builds a change.

specsDir.description: The OpenSpec root: change folders live in <specsDir>/changes/<id>/.

domains.description: Areas of the code. Every lane belongs to one domain; the domain says how its work is proven.

proof.description: How a change here is proven, in a sentence the builder reads.

gate.description: The command a builder runs before it reports done.

escalate.description: What a builder stops and reports instead of doing.

sensitivePaths.description: Named areas (auth, billing, migrations...). A lane that owns a path here waits for a person's decision before any builder starts. Guard-protected paths are always sensitive.

verify.description: How the verifier reaches the running app, and the little it may read and run. It only ever drives a local app.

health.description: URLs that must answer before any scenario runs.

credentialEnv.description: Names of environment variables that hold test sign-in credentials. Values are never printed.

instruments.description: How to exercise the app: which test runner, browser tool or HTTP calls.

readPaths.description: Globs the verifier may read besides the change's spec files and .verify/: test instruments such as page objects or fixtures. Everything else in the repository is closed to it.

commands.description: Commands the verifier may run besides curl to the local app, each as the words it starts with, such as ["npx", "playwright", "test"].

mcpServers.description: MCP servers the verifier may use, by name or part of a name (a browser server, for example). Every other MCP tool is closed to it.

sweep.description: Pages or endpoints the verifier loads once to catch regressions outside the scenarios.

checklist.description: The review checklist: lines of the form - `slug`: what to check. [review:slug] tags resolve here.

secondOpinion.description: A read-only command for a second model, given the review prompt as its last argument. Empty means none.

files.description: Globs of rulebooks whose rules must each name an enforcer.
